source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered 'Nitrogen' section with Table 12.1, printed pages 273-274.

blocks.text: Nitrogen periodic table ke group 15 se taalluq rakhti hai. Sanat mein nitrogen aam taur par hawa ko thanda kar ke liquid banane se hasil hoti hai; liquid nitrogen tezi se thanda karne ke liye aam istemal hoti hai. Laboratory mein nitrogen ammonium nitrite ke solution ko aahista garam kar ke banai ja sakti hai: NH4NO2(aq) se N2(g) + 2H2O(l).

blocks.prompt: Nitrogen hawa se kaise alag ki jati hai, aur laboratory mein kaise banai jati hai (exercise Q.2b)?
blocks.explanation: Sanati taur par hawa ko thanda aur dabaya jata hai jab tak woh liquid na ban jaye, aur nitrogen liquid hawa se alag ki jati hai (yeh -195.8 degrees C par ubal kar nikal jati hai). Laboratory mein ammonium nitrite ka solution halka garam kiya jata hai; woh toot kar nitrogen gas aur pani deta hai.

items: Nitrogen: group 15, Z = 7, [He] 2s2 2p3, be-rang gas, b.p. -195.8 degrees C; hawa ko liquid bana kar hasil, ya lab mein NH4NO2 garam kar ke N2 + 2H2O.
